enrichment.headline: Hires Terraphase Engineering for $69,064 in environmental review for Laurel Child Development Center
enrichment.summary: Terraphase Engineering will analyze air, noise, biological, tree, water and traffic impacts and prepare the exemption paperwork required under the California Environmental Quality Act for the new Laurel Child Development Center. The cost is $69,064, including a $6,276 contingency. Work runs May 13, 2021 through April 28, 2024.

enrichment.headline: Hires KW Engineering for $46,640 in systems commissioning design for Laurel Child Development Center
enrichment.summary: KW Engineering will prepare design documents for commissioning work, which checks that building systems and controls operate and communicate properly to save operating costs, for the Laurel Child Development Center replacement. The cost is $46,640, including a $10,000 contingency. Work runs May 13, 2021 through April 28, 2024.

enrichment.headline: Hires Jensen Hughes for $28,400 to review alarm designs at Laurel Child Development Center
enrichment.summary: Jensen Hughes will review the fire and intrusion alarm designs for the Laurel Child Development Center replacement to confirm they meet California building and fire codes and district standards, and will witness system testing. The cost is $28,400, including a $5,000 contingency. Work runs May 13, 2021 through May 12, 2024.

enrichment.headline: Hires HKIT Architects for $29,000 for Roosevelt Middle School modernization planning
enrichment.summary: HKIT Architects will complete the remaining programming and assessment phase of the Roosevelt Middle School modernization and provide services in a March 22, 2021 proposal. The total is $29,000: $19,000 for basic services plus a $10,000 district-controlled contingency. Work runs May 13, 2021 through May 21, 2024.

enrichment.summary: Terraphase Engineering will provide soil assessment consulting for the Laurel Child Development Center replacement site. The limit is $24,929, including up to $3,252 in contingency. Work runs May 13, 2021 through May 27, 2024.
